ref_file_title: Koh19 - Hunting and Gathering Verifiable Random Functions from Standard Assumptions with Short Proofs
note: Verified against vendor/cryptobib/crypto.bib entry PKC:Kohl19 (LNCS 11443 pp. 408–437, DOI 10.1007/978-3-030-17259-6_14; use cryptobib_key PKC:Kohl19) and the eprint 2019/042 abstract: same properties as HJ16 with proofs of l group elements for any l in omega(1) (logarithmic in the input length), instantiated in symmetric bilinear groups under DLIN.

note: J. Cryptology 22(2):161-188, 2009; also eprint 2004/175. First complete description and proof of security of Yao's protocol (semi-honest). cryptobib_key: JC:LinPin09 (verified in vendor/cryptobib/crypto.bib).

ref_file_title: LW10 - New Techniques for Dual System Encryption and Fully Secure HIBE with Short Ciphertexts
note: Verified against vendor/cryptobib/crypto.bib entry TCC:LewWat10 (LNCS 5978 pp. 455–479, DOI 10.1007/978-3-642-11799-2_27; use cryptobib_key TCC:LewWat10) and the eprint 2009/482 listing. Fully secure HIBE with short ciphertexts via dual system encryption in composite-order groups of three primes under three static assumptions.

ref_file_title: LW14 - Why Proving HIBE Systems Secure Is Difficult
note: Bibliographic data verified against cryptobib EC:LewWat14 (Eurocrypt 2014, LNCS 8441, pp. 58-76, DOI 10.1007/978-3-642-55220-5_4; eprint 2013/068); use `cryptobib_key: EC:LewWat14`. Content, from the verifier's knowledge (the abstract could not be fetched): for HIBE/ABE systems with a 'checkability' property on keys and ciphertexts (any two private keys that are both supposed to decrypt a ciphertext do so), any simple black-box reduction to a non-interactive assumption loses a factor exponential in the hierarchy depth (for ABE, in the number of attributes per ciphertext).

cryptobib_key: EC:Lyubashevsky12 (verified in vendor/cryptobib: EUROCRYPT 2012, pp. 738-755, DOI 10.1007/978-3-642-29011-4_43; eprint 2011/537). cryptobib and Springer render the title 'Lattice Signatures without Trapdoors'; eprint capitalises 'Without'. Contribution used here: signatures in the ROM from SIS with no trapdoor, via rejection sampling.
